proposal.thesis: Microsoft is the software and cloud layer of the AI stack, not a GPU-box OEM, and Tuesday 2026-09-15 is tagging the 20-day near $496 while the hardware names are still digesting Monday's Amodei/Altman dump. Bundle scan (prices_meta price_as_of 2026-09-14) has MSFT at $505.41, Stage-2 (above the 50- and 200-DMA, trend_up_50_over_200), 8.0% off the $553.72 52-week high, 52-analyst Strong Buy (mean 1.36) with a $572.92 target. Live is $499.05 at 10:19 a.m. ET (StockAnalysis), -1.26% on the day, range $499.10-$505.90, still under the written $508 fill; StockMonitor's daily MA20 is $495.87, so this bar is a 20-day tag (~0.3 ATR above it), not a 2x-ATR chase. Forward revenue growth is 17.8% and next-year EPS is modeled at $23.28 (+18.8%); FY2026 revenue was $331.84B (+17.8%, StockAnalysis). Stack differential versus DELL/HPE (hyperscaler_server_capex): the AI-spend question is whether ROI shows in cloud growth or is still just cost. Azure already crossed $100B of annual revenue in FY2026 Q4 on +43% growth (Nadella, July 30 call) and Bloomberg on 2026-09-10 reported a plan to triple owned/leased data-center capacity from ~12 GW to >38 GW by 2032 because Azure has been turning away paying customers. Demand_driver is mega_tech_platforms on a 100% cash book. ATR 2.07%; stop $476 sits below the 2026-08-17 $477.51 session low and ~2.3x ATR under a live fill near $499. Sized as a calibration probe (0.57) because FOMC is tomorrow. Horizon 40 days ends before the 2026-10-28 print.

Confidence 0.57 is a calibration probe into the FOMC print, not a stand-down.

proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: 52 analysts rate it Strong Buy (mean 1.36) with a $572.92 target (universe_scan / StockAnalysis still $572.92, +14.8% vs the $499.05 live mark at 10:19 a.m. ET 2026-09-15), and the Monday-Tuesday tape is pricing Amodei/Altman slowdown comments plus a ~92% odds Wednesday hike (CME FedWatch / Business Insider 2026-09-15) as a capex and duration derate for the whole AI stack, which is why MSFT spent last week in the $486-$510 area after the 2026-08-28 $517.78 high and why DELL/HPE/ANET dumped Monday. MY VIEW: Microsoft is capacity-short, not demand-short, and it is the software/cloud layer of the stack, not a GPU-box OEM — Tuesday's dip to ~$499, tagging StockMonitor's $495.87 20-day, while the hardware names are still digesting is the market starting to separate those cash-flow streams. MECHANISM: Bloomberg (2026-09-10, via TechTimes / Yahoo Finance 2026-09-11) reported Azure turning away paying customers and a plan to grow owned/leased data-center capacity from ~12 GW to >38 GW by 2032; FY2026 Q4 already printed Azure at a $100B annual run-rate on +43% growth and company revenue of $90.01B +18% (Nadella, July 30 call; FY2026 revenue $331.84B +17.8% on StockAnalysis), so a 25 bp hike that is already in the 4.96% 10-year hits DELL/HPE unit shipments first while Azure inference and Microsoft 365/GitHub seats run on the installed base. RESOLUTION: the 2026-10-28 FY2027 Q1 print, where Azure growth and capex guide either hold near the FY2026 17.8% revenue / Q4 Azure $100B / +43% marks or they do not.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: FY2027 Q1 results due 2026-10-28 showing Azure growth below 30% (versus the Q4 FY2026 +43% print) or company revenue growth below 15% versus the FY2026 17.8% run-rate, or a formal cut to calendar-2026 capex that management frames as demand destruction rather than lease reclassification.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A daily close below $476.00 on above-average volume, undercutting the 2026-08-17 session low of $477.51 by more than one ATR (2.07%).
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If MSFT has not printed a daily close above $520 (reclaim of the 2026-09-03 $510.12 / 2026-08-28 $517.78 area) by 2026-10-10, the Tuesday 20-day tag is a one-day pause rather than a Stage-2 reset — exit and rotate.
